lead.en: Edit a single line with a visible label, helper text and validation.
lead.zh: 编辑一行文字，标签、说明和校验结果始终跟随输入框。

rule.en: Tab or click the label to focus. Select, paste or use an IME. Enter submits.
rule.zh: Tab 或点击标签聚焦。支持选区、粘贴和输入法，Enter 提交。

api.en: FieldEvent reports changes as you type and when you submit. set_error accepts an empty string to clear validation.
api.zh: FieldEvent 报告值的变化与提交。set_error 传空字符串即可清除错误。

motion.en: The border tracks focus; validation appears beneath the field.
motion.zh: 边框跟随焦点，错误在输入框下展开。

lead.en: Write a multiline project note, select text across lines and drag the bottom corner to resize.
lead.zh: 编辑多行项目备注，可跨行选择文字或拖动右下角调整高度。

rule.en: Enter inserts a line. Shift with arrows extends the selection; drag the handle to change height.
rule.zh: Enter 换行，Shift 配合方向键扩选，拖动右下角改变高度。

api.en: Textarea preserves line breaks. set_description can display a live count supplied by the host.
api.zh: Textarea 保留换行。可通过 set_description 显示宿主计算的字数。

motion.en: Helper and error feedback stay below the editable area while resizing.
motion.zh: 调整高度时，说明和错误始终位于编辑区域下方。

avoid.en: Use Input for a single-line name.

lead.en: Reveal or mask an access key without losing the editing position.
lead.zh: 显示或隐藏访问密钥，并保留输入位置。

rule.en: Tab to the eye and press Enter or Space to reveal or mask the same value.
rule.zh: Tab 移到眼睛按钮，按 Enter 或空格切换明文与密文。

api.en: The initial value is masked. FieldEvent::Visibility reports whether it is revealed.
api.zh: 默认隐藏内容。FieldEvent::Visibility 通知宿主当前是否显示明文。

motion.en: A stroke travels across the eye while the value changes visibility in place.
motion.zh: 斜线在眼睛图标内绘出或收回，数值原位切换。

avoid.en: Use PasswordStrength when choosing a new password against a policy.
avoid.zh: 新密码要显示规则时使用 PasswordStrength。

lead.en: Check a new password against a visible policy as you type.
lead.zh: 输入新密码时，用四段指示条和规则清单查看满足情况。

rule.en: Type or paste, then activate the eye, Suggest one or Save. A failed policy check keeps your entry.
rule.zh: 输入或粘贴后可查看明文、生成示例或保存。校验未通过时保留输入内容。

api.en: Strength gives the 0–4 level and each rule result. Supply custom rules with with_policy.
api.zh: Strength 提供 0–4 级强度和各规则结果。可用 with_policy 配置自己的规则。

motion.en: Four segments fill in sequence and fulfilled rules draw checks. New errors shake once.
motion.zh: 四段指示条依次填充，已满足规则绘出勾号，新错误触发一次晃动。

avoid.en: Use PasswordField to sign in with an existing password.
avoid.zh: 登录时输入已有密码请用 PasswordField。

lead.en: Type a search query and clear it without shifting the toolbar.
lead.zh: 输入搜索词，一键清除后继续输入。

rule.en: Escape or Clear search resets the query. The clear action returns focus to the field.
rule.zh: Esc 或清除按钮清空搜索词，焦点留在输入框。

api.en: FieldEvent::Changed supplies the query, including the empty string after clearing.
api.zh: FieldEvent::Changed 提供最新搜索词，清除时值为空字符串。

motion.en: The clear icon scales inside a reserved slot.
motion.zh: 清除图标在预留位置缩放。

avoid.en: Use ExpandingSearch for a grouped result picker.
avoid.zh: 需要下拉分组结果时使用 ExpandingSearch。

lead.en: Open a compact search button, browse recent items and choose from grouped results.
lead.zh: 展开搜索按钮，查看最近项目或从分组结果中选择。

rule.en: Open with Enter or Space. Type to filter. Arrow keys wrap, Enter selects and Escape closes.
rule.zh: Enter 或空格展开，输入关键词筛选。上下键循环选择，Enter 确定，Esc 收起。

api.en: SearchItem has a stable ID, title, detail, group and keywords. Choose a result through SearchEvent::Selected.
api.zh: SearchItem 含稳定 ID、标题、说明、分组与关键词。通过 SearchEvent::Selected 接收选择。

motion.en: The field grows on a spring and one highlight follows the active row.
motion.zh: 输入框以弹簧展开，一片高亮跟随当前结果。

avoid.en: Use SearchField for an always-visible query.
avoid.zh: 始终可见、只需接受查询时使用 SearchField。

lead.en: Rename a project or edit its description in place, with validation and retry.
lead.zh: 就地修改项目名称或描述，支持校验、保存失败回退和重试。

rule.en: Activate the value to edit. Enter saves, Escape cancels, leaving saves. Shift+Enter inserts a line in descriptions.
rule.zh: 激活文字进入编辑，Enter 保存，Esc 取消，移开焦点保存。描述中 Shift+Enter 换行。

api.en: Subscribe to SaveRequest and call finish with its revision and result. An outdated response is ignored.
api.zh: 订阅 SaveRequest，完成后将此次 revision 和结果传回 finish，过期响应会被忽略。

motion.en: The pending draft appears immediately. Success draws a check; failure shows the saved value and a retry.
motion.zh: 保存时立即展示草稿，成功后绘出勾号，失败后显示原文和重试入口。

avoid.en: Use separate fields when a form saves several values together.
avoid.zh: 多项同时提交的表单请用独立字段。
